projects.title: False Hawks (2025)
projects.summary: Alex B stars as the town's drifter in the independent cosmic horror film False Hawks.

pages.title: Overview
pages.body:
Status: Completed

Starred as the Towns Drifter in the indie cosmic horror film, False Hawks (2025).

The film follows two detectives who have fallen from grace and are trying to unravel a supernatural, "cosmic mystery". The tone of the film is described as both "spooky" and "a knee slapper".

False Hawks was independently financed, with a crowdfunding campaign on Indiegogo run by director Seth Harris to cover production costs, including actor compensation, props, and travel.

IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt37244987/

projects.title: Fishtank.live
projects.summary: Alex B brought his storytelling, quick wit and larger-than-life personality to Season 3 of Fishtank.

pages.title: Overview
pages.body:
Status: Ongoing

A natural entertainer and one of the most memorable contestants from Season 3 of Fishtank, Alex B brought an unmatched energy and larger-than-life personality to the house from the moment he walked in. Known for his captivating storytelling and quick wit, he was a central figure in the season's most intense rivalries and alliances. Alex fearlessly stood up to online trolls, creating unforgettable moments as he passionately defended his family and pets on the live broadcast. Ultimately choosing to exit the show on his own terms, Alex has continued engaging with the Fishtank community through appearances on Magic Stars and a return as a freeloader during Fishtank Season 5.

about.heading: Alex B — The Monkey King
about.body:
Known online as The Monkey King, Alex B is an on-camera personality who brings high energy, quick wit and a direct connection with his audience to every project.

His work spans livestreaming, reality television, independent film and original live entertainment. He appeared in Seasons 3 and 5 of Fishtank, starred in the 2025 independent film False Hawks, and is developing Cobra Pit, an upcoming high-intensity game show.

This site is the official home for his current projects, appearances, community links and ways to get in touch.
